test_root: Absolute LP_INSTALL_TEST_ROOT; Rust private_json and Python lstat accept current-euid regular test-owner.json with no group/other mode and purpose LocalPilot installation E2E. Both canonicalize the directory and use client/.
transport: Both OS test targets use client/pet-control.sock through test_profile::TestProfile and data(app). The native server is started only in standalone pet mode (--companion-pet on the Test APP), not by opening the main window alone.

reports.inspect: client/pet-window-diagnostics.json, atomic fsync/rename, CLI checks new inode or mtime
reports.measure_animation: Test profile only, 6000 ms renderer sampling then client/pet-animation-probe.json, CLI timeout 12 seconds. Visible frames require separate actual recording/observation.
reports.other_actions: requested indicates command sent; action effect requires subsequent observable state.

compatibility: Existing macOS default and three allowed explicit bundle identifiers select ~/Library/Application Support/<id>. Existing show/hide/quit/center/inspect/anchor/character commands and command-string encoding preserved.
tests_reviewed: Existing new Python tests exercise exact client directory, ownership purpose mismatch and timeout/fresh-file replacement via real filesystem. This read-only review did not launch a native process or repeat GUI actions.
platform_limits: macOS diagnostics include monitor and native pointer counters. Linux portable diagnostics expose window visibility and position/size, edge and webview pointer input; collect display inventory separately.
